steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-section-absent-simple
steps.eval: (()=>{if(document.querySelector('.act-array--scatter'))throw new Error('scatter section visible in Simple mode');})()

steps.name: set-count
steps.eval: (()=>{const el=document.querySelector('.act-array--scatter input[aria-label="Number of copies to fill the room with"]');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set;set.call(el,'12');el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));})()

steps.name: assert-inside-and-no-overlap
steps.eval: (async()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const room=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='livingDining');const mod=await import('/src/floorplan/types.ts');const poly=mod.roomPolygon(room);const copies=s.items.filter(i=>i.id!=='src-chair'&&i.defId==='dining-chair');if(copies.length<2)throw new Error('expected multiple copies, got '+copies.length);for(const c of copies){if(!mod.pointInPolygon(c.position[0],c.position[1],poly))throw new Error('copy outside room: '+JSON.stringify(c.position));}for(let i=0;i<copies.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<copies.length;j++){const dx=copies[i].position[0]-copies[j].position[0];const dz=copies[i].position[1]-copies[j].position[1];if(Math.hypot(dx,dz)<0.3)throw new Error('copies too close (overlap): '+Math.hypot(dx,dz));}window.__scatterCount=copies.length;console.log('PROBE scatter placed copies='+copies.length);})()

steps.name: assert-one-undo-step
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();s.undo();if(window.__store.getState().items.length!==1)throw new Error('undo did not revert scatter in one step: '+window.__store.getState().items.length);})()
